why: This project IS the metered boundary. A gateway that proxies to OpenAI, Anthropic and xAI exists in order to hold provider keys in one audited place instead of scattering them through the fleet — so a metered key here is the design, not a silent assumption. ADR 0003 does not forbid metered access; it forbids metered access nobody decided on. This file records that decision so the fleet check reads a written exception rather than a violation.
scope: litellm-config.yaml provider entries only. Any OTHER component in this repo requiring a metered key is still a finding.
